stations.title: Kasimir
stations.say: One thing that builds it right.

stations.title: The bench
stations.text: One long command, typed again each time.

stations.title: The day book
stations.text: Built in steps, and the day summed up.

captions: Kasimir wants one thing to run that builds the five files of the day book right.
Today he types one long command after every change, and last week a file went missing.
You finish the day book's class and summary, and write its build, one file at a time.
The script builds each file apart, links them, and the day book sums up the day.
The workshop's slips are a program of its own now, built step by step at the bench.
